#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: Are you sure this is the right way?
You: I think so. I know this city pretty well.
Bot: I doubt there’s any fashion show around here. Why don't you tell me the address? It will be quicker.
You: We are almost there. {{wi}}I think.
Bot: You don’t sound very confident.
You: I’m as confident as I can be in this part of town.
You: There should be a door or something around here. Be on the lookout.
Bot: Sure.
Bot: There are stairs going down, but it seems like a service area. Look, the door down there is all covered with tape saying “out of service”.
You: That’s the only door around here. Let’s give it a try…
